name: Creek Horizon Waterfront Residences

thesis.whyInvest: Dubai Creek Harbour is positioning as Dubai's next financial and eco-tourism epicenter, offering prime waterfront capital appreciation potential.
growthDrivers: Proximity to upcoming Creek Tower landmark
Direct access to 600m natural beach corridor
Higher rental yields than traditional Downtown core
thesis.targetProfile: Long-term capital growth and stable expat tenant rental yields.

risks: Future construction inventory in adjacent Creek sectors
Delivery window aligned with multi-phase infrastructure

name: Orla Sunset Villa & Beach Suites

thesis.whyInvest: Ultra-luxury branded residency managed by Dorchester Collection. Prime west crescent Palm Jumeirah location with sunset horizon views.
growthDrivers: Extremely limited ultra-high-net-worth inventory on Palm Jumeirah
Dorchester Collection concierge & private butler services
Private infinity terrace pool per residence
thesis.targetProfile: UHNI global trophy asset collectors seeking prestige and privacy.

risks: Niche tenant pool focused exclusively on ultra-luxury short-term leases

name: The Oasis Sanctuary Mansions

thesis.whyInvest: Dubai Hills Estate is Dubai's premiere green heart community, surrounded by an 18-hole championship golf course and world-class hospital/schools.
growthDrivers: High family expat migration into gated villa communities
Dubai Hills Mall connectivity and central park proximity
Strong historical villa capital appreciation (+22% YoY)
thesis.targetProfile: Family-oriented HNW investors and long-term villa landlords.

risks: Maintenance reserves needed for large plot sizes

name: Palm Jebel Ali Frond Cove Villa

thesis.whyInvest: Dubai's mega flagship island development twice the size of Palm Jumeirah, capturing early-mover mega-appreciation.
growthDrivers: Direct alignment with Dubai Economic Agenda D33
First-mover pricing advantage prior to island completion
thesis.targetProfile: Strategic macro investors building generational real estate portfolios.

name: Downtown Edge Sky Tower

thesis.whyInvest: Direct views of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain with immediate access to Dubai Mall and DIFC financial hub.
growthDrivers: Consistently high corporate and holiday-home short-term rental occupancy
thesis.targetProfile: Short-term holiday home operators and international yield investors.

risks: Higher building service charges in Downtown core
Traffic density during peak tourist seasons

name: Canal Promenade Plaza

thesis.whyInvest: Waterfront Dubai Water Canal frontage with entry price point under AED 2M yielding robust 7.5% net returns.
growthDrivers: Strong tenant demand from young DIFC & Business Bay professionals
Direct water taxi boardwalk connecting to Jumeirah Beach
thesis.targetProfile: First-time Dubai investors and cash-flow focused portfolio owners.

risks: Sub-AED 2M price threshold requires top-up for Golden Visa
